/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag

tei:div.tei:p: /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo//

rnal 'byor pa gang zhig a phyi'i sgrub thabs/ rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pas rgyun du nyams su len pa/ rin po che'i cod pan le'u bco lnga ma nas btus pa'o// gsol kha byed par 'dod pas/ dus bzang dang tshes bcu la sogs pa la dben pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra legs par byas te/ rten gtor la sogs pa'i mdun nam/ med na rje btsun ma dang a phyi'i thang sku bkram la/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga bshams/ phye phud gtsang ma la gtor ma/ rab lnga/ 'bring gsum/ tha ma gcig byas la/ sha khrag gis legs par brgyan/ sin+dhu ra dang dri bzang dang*/ zas sna tshogs dang*/ shing thog sna tshogs dang*/ amṛ ta rnams dang*/ mda' dar sna lnga zhugs/ chab dang chang phud gtsang ma bran/ de'i mdun du lug sha lag pa g.yas pa/ zas rnam pa sna tshogs pa gang 'dzoms kyi tshogs chas/ spos dkar nag sogs mchod gtor thams cad bsags/ gsang sngags kyi rdzas rnams legs par tshogs par byas la/ de nas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor zhal gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa skad cig gis yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod nas/ nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu dha las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bh+rūṃ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/

dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rnam pa can/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ shapad 'i bar dang*/ gtor ma la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ pheṃ */ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan gyi mjug tu/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī i daṃ/ zhes gong bzhin 'gre/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra ha ri ni sa ma ma ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki ma ma bha dzaṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sogs kyis a phyi gtso 'khor la 'bul/ de nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun grub shog /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams rgyas zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog zhes sogs 'dod don du gsol ba btab/ de nas gzhi bdag gi gtor ma la dmigs te/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ sa bdag sa'i lha mo bstan mas gtso byas pa'i/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ mtsho ma pham/ tsā ri tsā gong*/ la phyi chu bar/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol ba'i mtsho bdun/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' dbus/

ri rab kyi steng shod/ stong gsum 'dzam gling na gnas pa'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du yang*/ chos rje'i dge bsnyen bar lha lha dang bcas pa/ sog ra btsan dang bcas pa/ ti sgro sman dang bcas pa/ chu 'phen klu dang bcas pa/ tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po/ sa ri sa skor/ lung pa phu mda'/ sa phyogs yul skor 'di kun tu gnas pa'i gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams la mchod gtor 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol lo// bzhes nas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa 'gro na ma bshol/ 'dug na ma bsgul/ 'tsho ba sbyor/ yon bdag gyis/ chos dang mthun pa'i sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ de nas bgegs gtor la dmigs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs 'jigs pa thams cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod la/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya kas gtso byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ mi 'dod pa bskyed par byed pa/ dge ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i steng gdon gza'/ 'og gdon klu/ bar gdon btsan la sogs pa gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi nas phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes brjod/ dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khwa gdong ma// badz+ra kaṃ ka zhes bya ba'i// shar sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// shar sgo srung ba'i las mdzod cig

/dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la 'ug gdong ma// badz+ra ul+lu zhes bya ba'i// byang sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// byang sgo srung ba'i las mdzod cig /dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma// badz+ra shwa na zhes bya ba'i// nub sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// nub sgo srung ba'i las mdzod cig /dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma// badz+ra su ka zhes bya ba'i// lho sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// lho sgo srung ba'i las mdzod cig /dzaḥ'adi ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// sgo ma rnams kyis sgo srungs la// mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams srungs shig /mtshams bcad gnas 'di tshun chad du// bgegs rnams 'da' bar ma byed cig / ces mtshams bcad/ de nas skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ 'og zangs ma'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte bar rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i 'og tu mun nag gi gru gsum zab pa gting ring ba zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du yi ge nṛ yongs su gyur pa las/ byad ma'i gzugs rid cing skem pa zhig bsam/ gdon bgegs thams cad khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis bkug la bstim nas 'gul bskyod mi nus par bsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i lte ba nas yar ka ba bslang ba'i tshul lta bu/ shel gyi rdo rje'i lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsam/ de'i dbus su rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa rgyan cha lugs mngon rtogs dang mthun pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar a phyi'i sa bon hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang ldan pa'i g.yas bskor la rang gi ming gis bskor bar bsgom/ shel gyi rdo rje'i steng gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa zhig gis thog phub pa bzhin bsgoms pa dang*/

zangs ma'i 'khor lo gnyis khrig gis bsgrigs pa'i bar dang gseng la rlung ser bu tsam yang mi thar bar bsgoms pa'i nang*/ shel gyi rdo rje la bskor ba byed pa'i sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam/ bsrung ba'i snying tig shin tu gces pa rnams shel gyi rdo rje dang mkha' 'gro ma'i bar der bsgom/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang*/ me ri rnams kyi gur khang bsgom/ me ri'i gur khang gi nang du las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ sha za mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas byad ma dgra bgegs gnod byed bkug tshar bcad bde ba'i ros gang ste/ bdag med ngang la bzhag 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod nas/ swa bhā wa dang*/ shū n+ya tā/ brjod pas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dbu skra sil bu'i tshogs grol pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po/ phyag g.yas na zangs kyi gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma ro yi gdan la sku gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bskyed/ de'i mdun du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po zlum po/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma ro yi gdan la/

yi ge hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas na dngul dkar gyi me long 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gsal bar 'char zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa dngos grub thams cad 'bar ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' sku la gsol ba/ zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud drag po las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la myur ba/ mthu stobs phrin las la thogs pa med pa/ bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi rtsibs kyi gdan la sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod cing*/ g.yon pas dam nyams kyi snying khrag gtso mo'i zhal du stob pa/ glang chen gyi pags pa sku la gsol zhing*/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi rtsibs kyi steng du/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtsug na nor bu/ sku mdog dkar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa gser gyi ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa rin po ches gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis sku la brgyan pa/ dar ljang khu'i na bza' lhub lhub tu gsol ba/ g.yon gyi rtsibs kyi steng du dam tshig mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa dbang gi rkyal ba bsnams shing*/ g.yon na thod pa yid bzhin gyi nor bus gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza' sku la gsol zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ rgyab kyi rtsibs kyi steng du dbang gi mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod cing*/

g.yon pas zas nor phywa g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi po thams cad kyang gtso mo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing*/ bka' nyan zhing gsung sgrub pa'o// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas u rgyan gyi gnas dang*/ bka' dang dam tshig gi gzhal yas nas rje btsun ma dang a phyi sna nam bza' mched lnga la mkha' 'gro ma bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra 'ur 'ur sil sil skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī dzñā na sa ma ya shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā// oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya nai wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/
oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa// ji bzhin nyid du rtogs gyur pa'i// gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon pa chags sogs khro mo'i zhal// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// bdag med skye med chos kyi dbyings// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug pa'i// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khril// zag med bde ba'i sku nyams ldan// sems can rnams la bde ster ma// phag mo yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// lte ba'i dbus na 'byung zhing 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams bsdud mdzad ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i tshogs// rnal 'byor ma la mchod par 'bul// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// dngos grub gnang phyir bzhes su gsol// bar chad sel phyir bzhes su gsol// 'dir gshegs bshams pa'i mchod gtor bzhes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ */ nam mkha' mthing bzang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// mu men mthing gi g.yu brag ti sgro nas// che zhes chen mo a phyi sna nam bza'// dgra bgegs 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// bdud bzhi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// dar dkar na bza' bdud rigs zil gyis gnon// zhi ba'i 'dzum ldan rin chen rgyan gyis spras// srid pa gsum gsal dngul dkar me long g.yas// dgos 'dod bsgrub pa'i nor bu g.yon na 'dzin// mthu stobs thogs med a phyi chos kyi sgron// u rgyan gnas dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// spyan 'dren mchod phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ dharma tā re pad+ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/

hūm̐ */ dpal ldan lha mo gtsug na nor bu ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar ser can// dar gyi na bza' in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /sku la gsol zhing rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs rin po che yis brgyan// phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ru drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas thugs kar thod pa rin chen bsnams// pad+ma'i gdan bzhengs gtso la 'dun pa'i tshul// u rgyan yul nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ dzñā na tā re pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan lha mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gcer bu grol// thod pas brgyan nas pad+ma'i gdan la bzhengs// phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon na lcags kyu bsnams// gtso la 'dun phyir dbang gi ngang tshul can// dam tshig gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma tra dha dhe ma tsakra pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ dpal ldan lha mo yid bzhin nor bu ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar skya'i mdog /le brgan dar dkar na bza' sku la gsol// phyag g.yas ne'u rkyal g.yon na nor bu bsnams// sna tshogs kyis brgyan pad ma'i gdan la bzhugs// gtso la 'dun zhing sems can dbul ba sel// dam tshig gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ sa ma ya tā re a tsakra pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro chen mo ni// sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon na thod pa bsnams// zhing lpags gsol zhing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// zhabs gnyis pus btsugs gtso mo'i bka' nyan byed// dgra bgegs tshar gcod lha mo spyan 'dren gyi// bar chad sel phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ bha sha ḍā ki nī ti ra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/ zhes brjod la spyan drangs/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā// oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rang gi mdun du bskyed pa'i a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byon nas/ sla nga'i nang du mar khu zhu ba bzhin du/ sib sib gnyis su med par bsam/ 'khor rnams la yang rang rang gnyis su med par bstim la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug brtan par byas la/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapad āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐// zhes dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ bdag bskyed kyi gtso mo la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing*/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhing*/

dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur pa'i rang gi thugs kar yi ge baṃ dmar po'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭ/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo'i thugs kar/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma tā re ma ma 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki nī/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+yai puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye 'dus/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ swā hā/ mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhis kyang bzlas pa byed par bsgoms la/ sngags gong 'og gnyis ma skyo ba'i bar la bzlas/ de nas nang mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rnam pa can/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ lan gsum brjod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thabs bde ba'i brdar zlum skor gcig bya/ de nas shes rab stong pa'i brdar gru gsum nyis brtsegs bri/

de nas lag pa gnyis po'i mthil du nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā li kā li'i yig 'bru rnams dmigs te/ ā li kā li zla ba dang bcas pa chang la thim pas/ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha tshogs la sman mchod rgyas par 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'gre/ yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a mes tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yung drung rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nam mkha' dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpe ka dbang rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsod nams dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ka thung gru bzhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan po dar ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btsun pa 'bar gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba gcung gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal sras thog kha ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos gzhi lag pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang srin lag sprad la/ bdud rtsi la reg nas zlum bskor dang chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su baṃ las phag mo dmar mo/ chos 'byung gi zur rnams su/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ las gtum pa mo dud kha rnams rim pa bzhin bskyed/ yang mthe bong nas brtsams te/ oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa'/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad/ swa hā hu las pad+ma gar dbang*/ bo ṣa ṭa he las he ru ka mthing kha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ las don grub ljang khu rnams rim pa bzhin gsal bar bsgoms te/ bdud rtsi g.yon thabs rdzas g.yas su byas nas 'bul/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ hum̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ phaṭ haṃ swā hā/ de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yon chab mtha' yas bla na med pa 'di// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings rnams bkang nas ni// dus gsum bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog mchod// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus kyi dri ma dag bya'i phyir// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// kha dog dbyibs legs rin chen me tog 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ye shes sgron me ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// ye shes snang bas phyogs kun gsal gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī ā lo ke pra ti'ats+tsha swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur ba'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chu// ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dril chen gsung snyan sgra sgrog tshangs pa'i dbyangs// rnga bo che sogs dung dang sgra snyan dang*// gsung dbyangs ngag gis bstod de gus 'bul na// sems can rnams la chos sgra sgrog par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra wā rā hī shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā// hūm̐ */ nub phyogs u rgyan gzhal yas nas// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// skyil krung phyed pa ro yi gdan// gcer bu skra grol sku mdog dmar// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// g.yon pa khro zhal spyan gsum ldan// nyon mongs gcod mdzad gri gug g.yas// thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// mi rus phreng ba'i rgyan dang ldan// zhing chen rus rgyan sku la gsol/

khyod ni stong nyid snying rje'i bdag /rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ baṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dmar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab mdzes bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma// rdo rje phag mo phyag 'tshal bstod// haṃ yoṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// sngon mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// sgeg mo'i stobs kyis gar nyams mdzad// gshin rje ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hrīṃ moṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dkar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab mdzes rdzu 'phrul stobs 'chang ma// rmongs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hriṃ hrīṃ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ser mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// sdig pa 'joms mdzad 'od zer 'bar// skyod byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// hum̐ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ljang khu gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// dpa' mo'i mtshan can drag shul can// skrag byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// phaṭ phaṭ las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// nag mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// rab 'jigs khro mo'i cha lugs can// tsaṇ+ḍi ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ ha sa bon dkar po las// zhal gsum phyag drug mdzes pa'i sku// spyan gsum mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod// na ma hi ni ser po las// dpa' bo ral pa'i thor gtsug can// ya mtshan dar dang rus pas brgyan// rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// swā hā hu las byung ba yi// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar// spyan gsum mche gtsigs gdug pa 'dul// pad+ma gar dbang phyag 'tshal bstod// bau ṣaṭa he ni mthing kha las// g.yas brkyang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// phyag rgya drug gis rab tu brgyan// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// huṃ hūm̐ ho ni dpa' bo'i gzugs// thabs mchog sgeg pa'i gar nyams ldan// 'khor lo nor bu'i do shal mdzes// rin chen nyi ma phyag 'tshal bstod// phaṭ phaṭ haṃ las byung ba yi// ljang khu phrin las grub mdzad cing*// gri thod ral gri ḍa ma ru// rab bsnams dpa' bor phyag 'tshal bstod/

༈ kyai bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ yongs su gang bar mdzad du gsol/ shin tu gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/

zhes lan gsum brjod/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i gter du gyur pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ lag pa'i lha tshogs rnams rang gi spyi gtsug tu thim/ oṃ zhes phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pas lus byin gyis brlabs/ āḥ zhes phyag rgya mgrin par gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pas ngag byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ zhes rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas snying khar sbyar bas yid byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang mas yar ldog nas phyag rgya dang bcas te/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes srung bar 'gyur ro/ 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da nang gi mchod pa 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras 'khur dang*// thabs gti mug maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /thig le rkang dang khu ba zhag /tshogs dang rak+ta'i longs spyod 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga yi mchod pa dang*// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /snying zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// pañtsa a mṛ ta yi mchod pa 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu ram la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum ar+ghaṃ mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas skye med rtogs par shog /dri zhim sman gyi mchod pa dang*// gzugs sdug sgra snyan 'dod yon tshogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba 'di// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// longs spyad pas 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// sku bde ba chen por gyur ba'i rdzas// longs spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'phel gyur cig /gnod sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// longs spyad pas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas nyon mongs 'dod chags kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// thugs mnyam nyid chos skur gyur pa'i rdzas// longs spyad pas sems rgyud ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'phel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug tshogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan ba'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ hūm̐ */ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag cag 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor gyi// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad la// ye shes chen po lnga ldan pa'i// bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis rlobs par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems mnyam nyid chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du ni// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams sol// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//

de nas tshogs phud dang bdud rtsi gtor ma la bran te/ hūm̐ */ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// dgyes pa mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rdo rje phag mo la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ bcom ldan bud+dha he ru kaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ bcom ldan badz+ra he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ bcom ldan rat+na he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen rin chen mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ bcom ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro la// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */

bcom ldan karma he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*// dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal// 'jigs su rung ba bskal ba'i me// dmar nag 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil nas// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// yum chen tsaṇ+ḍi dbang phyug ma// 'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// 'khor nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// hūm̐ */ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// a phyi chos kyi sgron ma la// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor// ma lus 'khor tshogs thams cad la// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen 'di// gnyis med ngang du 'bul lags na// blang dor med par bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par rol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ༈ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bh+rūṃ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor aṃ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rnam pa can/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhriḥ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra ha ri ni sa sa ma ya ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs zhes rje btsun ma lha lnga la 'bul/ gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs te/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ i daṃ ba liṃta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul lo// mchod do// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gnod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa la dmigs la/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa rī dharma dzñā na sa ma ya/ tā re dhe ma ḍā ki nī/ sarba ma ma bha dzaṃ i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sna nam gza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang phyug mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos rje'i spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes nas dam bcas pa bzhin/

bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad dang gnod pa rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes brjod nas/ bzhi pa la dmigs la/ oṃ kar+ṇa warti/ thun me ri i daṃ ba liṃ= oṃ dha ka pa dha ri tsā muṇ+ḍi tista rbad lo i daṃ= oṃ a nan ha ra gyi ni me thun phre ye i daṃ= oṃ ni ti ma ti su ru ma ti i daṃ= oṃ dha ki ta kra ma ni dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaḥ.i daṃ= jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'bul lo// mchod do// dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes shing dam bcas pa bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod// ces brjod/ yang gtor ma de rang byin gyis brlab la/ oṃ de wa ru dra ma ra ya i daṃ/ bhi sha dur mi ta dhe ḍā ki nī i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi khā/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma sman raka bdud rtsis bran pa 'di/ srog gcod nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ phrin las sha za mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ ser chags kyi mgon skyabs mdzod/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa rgyu sbyor dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ bsam sbyor ngan pa shom pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar chod/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyong*/ thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ zhes brjod do/ /yang lnga pa la dmigs te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ brjod/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la sogs pa dpal mgon bdun cu 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/

ci bsam pa'i don thams cad chos bzhin du sgrubs/ zhes pa dang*/ de'i rjes su/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub shog /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byang stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces rgyas par bsngo/ ༈ /ma hrīḥsngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis/ chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs/ ye shes kyi dbyings nas spyan gyis gzigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang gis phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du byon par mdzad du gsol/ a phyi sna nam bza'/ dbang phyug chos kyi sgron ma/ ye shes kyi sgron ma/ dam tshig gi sgron ma/ dbang gi lha mo/ sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ pha mes rgyud kyi srung ma/ dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma/

bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams la/ ye shes la gsal 'grib mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yon tan gyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phrin las kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis gsol zhing mchod pa'i rten dam pa 'di la bzhugs nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad sel zhing*/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las skyel ma dam pa mdzad du gsol/ lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi ltung zhing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi phyogs su blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten 'dir yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus shing*/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phrin las kyi bya ba la gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal dang mgon du gyur nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med pa bde blag tu stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab cing rgyal bar gyur cig

lhag ma ni/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ bh+yoḥ shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// rnal 'byor bdun gyi gtso mo ni// dkar mo dung gi thor gtsug can// gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal// grub ni chos kyi dbyings su grub// de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang*// 'dir byon lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// khyed kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig bh+yoḥ lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// rnal 'byor bdun gyi gtso mo ni// ser mo gser gyi thor gtsug can// gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal// grub ni chos kyi dbyings su grub// de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang*// 'dir byon lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// khyed kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig / bh+yoḥ nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// rnal 'byor bdun gyi gtso mo ni// dmar mo byu ru'i thor gtsug can// gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal// grub ni chos kyi dbyings su grub// de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang*// 'dir byon lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes// khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig bh+yoḥ byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// rnal 'byor bdun gyi gtso mo ni// ljang mo g.yu yi thor gtsug can// gcig ni thabs kyi sku ru gsal// grub ni chos kyi dbyings su grub// de ltar g.yog 'khor bye ba yang*// 'dir byon lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig / ces lhag ma btang*/ skabs 'dir bskang yig bklag de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥdabyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// nyi shar gangs ltar dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan// gzugs bzang gzi brjid 'od phreng drwa ba 'gyed// lta sdug yid 'ong a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// zhabs 'og bdud bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mnan// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long mdzes pa bsnams// srid gsum gsal mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yon yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// rgyal ba ma lus mnyes par mdzad pa yi// sems can kun gyi dgos 'dod re skong ma// tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// lha min gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// bdud 'joms lha min g.yul ngo zlog par mdzad// dkar po lha yi chab srid dbugs 'byin ma// phrin las bzhi ldan a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// srid gsum dbang bsdud 'gro ba ma lus skyong*// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa srung bar mdzad// 'gro ba'i bsam pa chos bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// yid bzhin bsam 'grub a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// byang chub thugs kar kun bzang chos kyi sgron// lha mi 'jig rten kun nas skyong mdzad ma// gling bzhi kun tu rgyu ba'i drag mo rgyal// dpal ldan chos kyi sgron mar phyag 'tshal bstod// deng sang bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan// dpal gyi 'bri gung pho brang brtan bzhugs nas// chos mdzad sgrub pa po rnams skyong mdzad ma// bka' srung yang dag a phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// bslab gsum rgyan ldan grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// zhing bsam dngos gsum rten cing 'brel par 'byung*// ma nor tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas mchod gyur na// ci 'dod dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyed la mchod cing gsol ba yis// 'gro drug chu bor bying ba'i ma rgan rnams// nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du mi gtong zhing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// khyad par chos rje'i bka' srung thugs dam can// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po srungs// zas su dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor bzhes// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hrīḥ

bzhin bzang dbyings phyug dpal ldan chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar 'gyur med 'gying bag can// 'khor ba'i log lta skem byed 'od mnga' ma// bde chen dga' ster rab dgyes dpa' mo ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi byed 'dzum pa'i sku// phyag g.yas ḍa ru snyan pa kun khyab sgrog /g.yon pa thod pas dngos grub kun stsol zhing*// za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' sku la gsol// rin po ches brgyan dar gyi cod pan can// chibs su sprin gseb chu rta gro sngon bcibs// dar chen blo nan mu men yob chen 'khrol// g.yu mthur sngon po gser srab ser pos rgyan// za 'og dar gdan gser sga'i sga steng du// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo bzhad pa'i tshul// snying rje chen pos pho nya rdzu 'phrul ston// lha min gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// phrin las bzhi ldan spros med ngang tshul can// phun sum tshogs gnas dpal gyi 'bri gung gi// longs spyod spel phyir bka' srung kun mdzad ma// bstan pa srung phyir gtor ma 'di bzhes las// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ bh+yoḥ rin chen las grub g.yos kyang*// brtse ba chen pos 'gro la rab dgongs te// sna tshogs sprul pas sgyu ma'i gzugs bzung nas// snang srid dbang bsdud khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod kyi rab dkar dang ba'i mdangs mchog
